## Registry Aggregator 0.4.13

0.4.13 restores the fast and stable registry-discovery path and keeps GitHub popularity metadata out of the critical Browse path.

### Highlights

- restored npm/GitHub source discovery and source counters;
- restored fast empty-query and keyword Browse behavior;
- kept exact and partial package-name discovery, including scoped npm packages;
- kept verification of `dsh.bundle.patch` before exposing install actions;
- moved missing GitHub star resolution to a separate asynchronous request after cards render;
- star lookups are cached, best-effort, and limited to the visible page;
- GitHub statistics failures no longer delay or fail Browse;
- refreshed README with current Sources and Browse screenshots.

### Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness: `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.2.0`
- tested with DSH `0.1.7-rc.1`
